title: camera
description: Transforms the camera for the selected player(s) to a different perspective.

preset.title: preset
preset.description: A camera preset defined in a camera JSON file.

ease.title: ease
ease.description: Signifies the start of a section for defining ease override parameters.

easetype.title: easeType
easetype.description: Specified type of the easing to use.

pos.title: pos
pos.description: A subsection of the command for defining a position.

position.title: position
position.description: The position to locate the camera at.

rot.title: rot
rot.description: Specifies a subsection of the command for defining a rotation.

facing.title: facing
facing.description: Specifies a facing section of the camera command.

lookatentity.title: lookAtEntity
lookatentity.description: A target selector to use for looking at an entity.

default.title: default
default.description: Specifies that the camera movement should be reset to its default parameters.

targetentity.title: targetEntity
targetentity.description: Targeted entity that the camera should focus on

targetcenteroffset.title: targetCenterOffset
targetcenteroffset.description: Specifies that there should be offset coordinates for cameras that have a particular coordinate

xtargetcenteroffset.title: xTargetCenterOffset
xtargetcenteroffset.description: X offset from the center of a targeted entity

ytargetcenteroffset.title: yTargetCenterOffset
ytargetcenteroffset.description: Y offset from the center of a targeted entity

ztargetcenteroffset.title: zTargetCenterOffset
ztargetcenteroffset.description: Z offset from the center of a targeted entity

removetarget.title: removeTarget
removetarget.description: Value that indicates a target should be removed

view_offset.title: view_offset
view_offset.description: Specifies that there should be offset coordinates of a view

xviewoffset.title: xViewOffset
xviewoffset.description: X component of a view offset

yviewoffset.title: yViewOffset
yviewoffset.description: Y component of a view offset

clear.title: clear
clear.description: Clears any existing camera update documentation.

fade.title: fade
fade.description: Specifies the start of a fade definition section of the command.

time.title: time
time.description: Specifies the start of a time section of a camera command.

holdseconds.title: holdSeconds
holdseconds.description: Specifies the amount of time to hold the camera view.

fadeoutseconds.title: fadeOutSeconds
fadeoutseconds.description: Specifies the number of seconds to fade out the camera.

color.title: color
color.description: Specifies the start of a color section of a camera set command.

red.title: red
red.description: Red component of a color value. Valid values are between 0 and 255.

green.title: green
green.description: Green component of a color value. Valid values are between 0 and 255.

blue.title: blue
blue.description: Blue component of a color value. Valid values are between 0 and 255.

fov_clear.title: fov_clear
fov_clear.description: Clears any existing camera update documentation.
